A Counter resource is a numbered variable, mainly used in Label Format of pools to number volumes.

## Examples

**Volume numbers that wrap every year**

```text
Counter {
  Name = Week
  Minimum = 1
  Maximum = 53
  Catalog = MyCatalog
}

Pool {
  Name = Weekly
  Label Format = "Weekly-${Week+}"
}
```

## Directives

| Directive | Type | Default | | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Name](#d-name) | name |  | required | Name of the counter, used as a variable in Label Format (for example ${Weekly}). |
| [Description](#d-description) | string |  |  | Free text describing the counter. |
| [Minimum](#d-minimum) | integer | `0` |  | Value the counter starts with and returns to after Maximum. |
| [Maximum](#d-maximum) | positive integer | `2147483647` |  | Highest value; then the counter wraps to Minimum (and increments Wrap Counter). |
| [Wrap Counter](#d-wrapcounter) | resource |  |  | Counter that is incremented whenever this one wraps, for nested numbering such as week within year. |
| [Catalog](#d-catalog) | resource |  |  | Catalog the value is stored in; without it the counter lives in memory only and restarts at each Director start. |

### Name {#d-name}

Key: `name` · Type: name · Required

Name of the counter, used as a variable in Label Format (for example ${Weekly}).

```text
Counter {
  Name = "Weekly"
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add counter name=Weekly
```

### Description {#d-description}

Key: `description` · Type: string

Free text describing the counter.

```text
Counter {
  Name = Weekly
  Description = "Volume number of the weekly pool"
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add counter name=Weekly description="Volume number of the weekly pool"
```

### Minimum {#d-minimum}

Key: `minimum` · Type: integer · Default: `0`

Value the counter starts with and returns to after Maximum.

```text
Counter {
  Name = Weekly
  Minimum = 1
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add counter name=Weekly minimum=1
```

### Maximum {#d-maximum}

Key: `maximum` · Type: positive integer · Default: `2147483647`

Highest value; then the counter wraps to Minimum (and increments Wrap Counter).

```text
Counter {
  Name = Weekly
  Maximum = 52
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add counter name=Weekly maximum=52
```

### Wrap Counter {#d-wrapcounter}

Key: `wrapcounter` · Type: resource

Counter that is incremented whenever this one wraps, for nested numbering such as week within year.

```text
Counter {
  Name = Weekly
  Wrap Counter = "Year"
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add counter name=Weekly wrapcounter=Year
```

### Catalog {#d-catalog}

Key: `catalog` · Type: resource

Catalog the value is stored in; without it the counter lives in memory only and restarts at each Director start.

```text
Counter {
  Name = Weekly
  Catalog = "MyCatalog"
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add counter name=Weekly catalog=MyCatalog
```
